subject: Urgent: Candidate delayed after car accident — day-of triage and options
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@talenthire.io
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: running late — accident on way to interview

Hi Grace,

I am really sorry to do this last minute — I was in a minor car accident on the way to the office (no major injuries, but my car is disabled and I'm waiting for a tow). I’m currently at the scene and unlikely to make our 9:00am panel on time.

If possible, can we either:
- move my interview to later today (I should be available mid-afternoon), or
- do the session by phone now/at a later time, or
- if neither works, I’m happy to complete a recorded take-home exercise or a short phone screen first.

I attached a quick photo of the car (photo-damage.jpg) so you have context. I’m really excited about the role and don’t want this to derail things — apologies again for the disruption. My cell is 415-555-0182.

Thanks for understanding,
Liam

Attachment: photo-damage.jpg (image/jpeg)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, scheduling@talenthire.io
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 07:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: running late — accident on way to interview

Hi Liam — thanks for the update and glad to hear you’re OK.

Marcus / Stephanie — FYI, Liam just had a minor accident en route. We have three realistic options to keep momentum:

1) Move today’s panel to 3:00–4:00pm PT (if that works for everyone)
2) Do the planned interview by phone at the later time or right now if he can call in
3) Convert to a short asynchronous take-home and reconvene for a live panel later this week

Scheduling — can you propose open slots for 3pm–5pm today and copy a new calendar invite if a time is confirmed? If Marcus/Stephanie prefer to keep their calendars, flag and we’ll swap with volunteers.

Liam — no need to send more photos. If phone is easiest, what time works best today? We can also do a phone screen first and follow up with a panel when you’re able.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Recruiting Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | 415-555-0127
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>, scheduling@talenthire.io
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: running late — accident on way to interview

Grace — thanks for the heads up. I can shift my afternoon and cover the panel at 3:00pm PT today if that lets Liam join. If 3pm is tight for Stephanie, I can also push to 4pm.

If Liam prefers a phone screen now, I’m available at 10:30am PT for a quick 20–30 minute touchpoint and we can follow up with the full panel later in the week.

Happy to be flexible — whatever keeps the candidate engaged.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: TalentHire Scheduling <scheduling@talenthire.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: running late — accident on way to interview — new invite

Hi all — per Grace/Marcus, Liam has been moved to a 3:00pm PT slot today. I created a new calendar invite and attached the .ics. Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Invite details: 2027-09-21 15:00–16:00 PT — Onsite panel (phone option: +1 415-555-0100).

Liam — please confirm whether you’ll call the number or accept a calendar-generated dial-in. If you end up needing a recorded take-home instead, let us know and we’ll remove the live panel.

Attachment: reschedule-invite.ics
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, TalentHire Scheduling <scheduling@talenthire.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: running late — accident on way to interview — new invite

Thanks everyone — I’ll be okay, just shaken up and with a couple of scrapes. I can definitely do 3:00pm PT by phone. I’ll call +1 415-555-0100 and use the calendar link as backup.

Appreciate the flexibility and sorry again for the day-of chaos — looking forward to speaking with the team.

Best,
Liam

(Phone: 415-555-0182)
